visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up of freshly baked golden-brown salted bread rolls (Shio Pan) on metal trays. A man with a striped shirt and short dark hair takes a massive, enthusiastic bite of a large bread roll filled with a thick layer of white cream. The background is a brightly lit bakery interior with glass displays. (2) Nighttime view of a busy street in Bangkok, specifically the Chulalongkorn area. Neon signs from various shops light up the sidewalk where people are walking and cars are parked. The camera pans to the entrance of 'Bake A Wish Baker,' which has a modern, circular counter and bright logo. (3) Inside the shop, the camera focuses on a display of pastries, including chocolate-covered rolls labeled 'Dubai Choco-Burger.' A staff member wearing a mask and black gloves is seen meticulously cutting a fresh strawberry to place onto a cream-filled pastry on a small plate. The lighting is warm and inviting. (4) The man in the striped shirt is seen again, holding up the cream Shio Pan to the camera, emphasizing the generous filling. Next, a staff member pours vibrant green liquid matcha over a cup of green tea soft serve ice cream. The presentation is professional, served on a wooden tray. (5) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a grey plaid shirt, sits cross-legged on a hotel room floor. She holds a box containing the strawberry cream pastry and takes a delighted bite, smiling broadly at the camera. The room is dimly lit with warm bedside lamps, creating a cozy atmosphere.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic male voice begins narrating in Traditional Chinese with high pitch variability and excitement. A mid-tempo, upbeat pop BGM with electronic keyboard textures starts immediately. The vocal delivery is clear and projected, set against a clean studio-like narration track overlaying the video. (2) Transition to on-site audio. The male voice continues, but there is now a subtle background noise of urban traffic and muffled street chatter. The BGM remains constant at a moderate volume. The speaker's tone remains highly enthusiastic, emphasizing the novelty of the bakery found during the walk. (3) Sound of a plastic bag rustling as a pastry is handled. The narration continues with a focus on the variety of flavors. The BGM beat remains steady. The acoustic texture is mixed, combining the polished narration with incidental sounds of the bakery environment, including soft metallic clinks. (4) A second voice, a female, is heard briefly with a high-pitched exclamation of 'Eh!' and 'Very powerful!'. Sound of biting and chewing is audible as she reacts to the food. The BGM maintains its tempo, and the male narrator returns to provide concluding recommendations and shop details.
